entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manik Chandra,Virendra Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.

The present bail application has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 78 of 2025, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Pholpur, District- Allahabad during pendency of the trial.
At the outset, Sri Manik Chandra, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present application with liberty to file afresh at an appropriate stage.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
Let the certified copy of the documents, if any, be returned to the counsel for the applicant as per Rules of the Court.
